content.title: Tambaram City Police Arrest 26 in Special Drive Against Ganja and Banned Tobacco Products
content.caption: Tambaram City Police arrested 26 persons during a special enforcement drive against illegal sale and distribution of ganja and banned tobacco products.

slides.heading: Tambaram City Police Arrest 26 in Special Drive Against Ganja
slides.text: Tambaram City Police arrested 26 persons during a special enforcement drive against illegal sale and distribution of ganja and banned tobacco products.

slides.heading: Operation Details
slides.text: The operation involved 89 special teams comprising 450 police personnel.

slides.heading: Arrested Persons
slides.text: 26 persons were arrested, of whom 20 were remanded in judicial custody.
